overall_reason: A plum #6d5964 holds the one action 'Download package' and tints the file icon on a warm mauve stage, but the window text mixes cool slate greys with mauve greys across six levels.

score.reason: T-COLOUR-SOURCE and T-ACCENT-DOSAGE pass for the plum, while T-NEUTRALS finds two neutral families and T-PALETTE-ROLES finds six text greys.

findings.title: Neutrals hold one temperature
findings.where: window text: eyebrow 'Campaign launch', subtitle 'Everything your team needs to publish.', heading 'Launch package', 1440 and 375, C:\Users\warwicka\Documents\unslop-runs-set2\P31\01-evidence\tiles\1440-00.png
findings.evidence: The palette table counts 9 warm mauve neutrals (#6c6269, #8f858c, #969095, stage #ede5e5) against 4 cool slate ones (#83909a, #84909a, #35414a): the eyebrow, subtitle and h1 use the cool slate while the sidebar and meta use the mauve greys.
findings.before: Cool slate text (#35414a, #83909a) beside mauve greys (#6c6269, #969095) on a warm #f6f5f4 panel
findings.after: One neutral family tinted toward the plum anchor, used for every text grey
findings.why: Two grey families in one window read as two kits; the cool slate text looks out of place on the warm panel.

findings.title: Text greys are a fixed set
findings.evidence: The palette table finds 6 text levels on one light ground: #262628, #35414a, #6c6269, #8f858c, #83909a and #969095.
findings.after: Three text greys from one family: ink, secondary, meta
findings.why: Six close greys blur the roles; the eyebrow and the sidebar items sit one or two steps apart with no reason.

strengths: The plum #6d5964 appears on the one primary action and the file-icon tint only.
One shadow recipe, tinted toward a hue rather than black.
not_investigated: Brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours or design system were available; T-COLOUR-SOURCE was judged from the composition alone, and the visitor mode was taken as Operate (a product UI component).
T-DARK-MODE: the stylesheet ships a dark class theme, but the capture rendered only the light scheme, so dark mode is not verified.
T-GRADIENT-STOPS and contrast: owned by the sweep (A11-001); small-text contrast hits are not restated here.
